instruction: Have I returned any crescent wrench on amazon in this or last month? Say yes or no.
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes are allowed, so all actions except complete_task are lookups. Current date is 2023-05-18, so the window is April and May 2023; the agent filters amazon.show_returns by created_at, then calls amazon.show_product (no token needed) on the returned product ids to check whether any is a crescent wrench. The single answer object answer-yes-or-no is bound at runtime to "yes"/"no"; the candidate product object stands for the returns found in the window (show_product may be repeated per return at execution time). The returned-product fact is a static marker identifying the record discovered via show_returns; its id becomes known only after that call.
